We need number of CH3 groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is the one we have access to via NMR tools. We need to determine methyl groups from NMR spectra. Could get carbon NMR to see number of methyl carbon signals. Or proton NMR to see methyl peaks. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool to get 1H NMR. Then count distinct methyl signals (triplet? integration?). The tool returns spectra as string; we need interpret. Might be easier: carbon_nmr_spectra to see number of signals around 10-30 ppm typical for methyl. But need count of CH3 groups, not distinct signals maybe. Could be ambiguous.

We need to minimize cost. Probably just get proton NMR and count methyl peaks. Use proton_nmr_spectra.
